answers.how: In the late frames, the card measures approximately 94 px long and 64 px wide. Width = 8.56 × 64/94.
Positions around 0.40–0.60 s give a local speed of approximately 338 px/s. Using the card's approximately 89 px length at 0.50 s gives 338 × 8.56/89.
Tracking the card around 0.90–1.10 s gives approximately 65 px/s. Scaling by its approximately 94 px length gives 65 × 8.56/94.
A local second-difference estimate around 0.50 s gives an acceleration magnitude of approximately 894 px/s². Scaling by 8.56/89 converts this to cm/s².
